name: 06416 · Cromwell, CT
findings: ZIP 06416 (Cromwell) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06416 (Cromwell) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06416 (Cromwell) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
